items.q: What did Dijkstra say about testing?
items.a: Testing shows the **presence of bugs, never their absence**.

items.q: Why can 100% coverage still miss bugs?
items.a: Coverage proves lines ran, not that **all inputs** behave correctly.
It explores the input maze semi-randomly and **never covers everything**.

items.q: What is a law in Bend?
items.a: A property that must hold **for every possible input**, checked with a Lean proof.

items.q: How did the flag demo work?
items.a: A law proved the player **can never reach the flag**; deleting a wall made the proof fail.
Humans **write the laws**, agents **write the proofs**.
